document: Map extract or map data sheet listing notable locations
glossary: Document type: Map extract or map data sheet listing notable locations. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.map_source: the map source as printed on the document (A terkepi adatok forrasa/attribucioja, ahogy a dokumentumon szerepel (pl. OpenStreetMap es kozremukodoi))
field_specs.area_name: the area name as printed on the document (A megjelenitett terulet vagy telepules neve (pl. Pilisvorosvar), ha olvashato)
